title: SLAMF8-marked macrophage and HSC transcriptomic analysis in human MASLD
description: Portable analysis code, processed figure-level Source Data, Supplementary Tables S1–S14, final PDF figures and reproducibility metadata supporting a cross-cohort human MASLD transcriptomic study. Third-party raw GEO data are not redistributed.
